name: slack_webhook
description: Send messages to a Slack channel via incoming webhook
prerequisites: Slack webhook URL from the user

steps.description: Test the webhook with a simple message

example_params.command: curl -s -X POST "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"text": "Hello from NLS agent!"}'

error_patterns: channel_not_found - webhook URL is invalid or expired
recovery_hints: Verify the webhook URL with the user

steps.description: Send a formatted message with blocks

example_params.command: curl -s -X POST "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"blocks": [{"type": "header", "text": {"type": "plain_text", "text": "Status Update"}}, {"type": "section", "text": {"type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Task completed* successfully.\nAll tests passing."}}]}'

example_params.content:
#!/bin/bash
MSG="${1:-No message provided}"
curl -s -X POST "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"text\": \"$MSG\"}"

learning_signals: Slack webhooks accept POST requests to https://hooks.slack.com/services/...
Block Kit allows rich formatting: headers, sections, dividers, buttons
Webhook returns 'ok' on success, error string on failure
